attributes.title: 2027 GANE Conference: Excellence and Innovation in Nursing Education
attributes.venue: Augusta Marriott at the Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Association for Nursing Education meets February 25 to 27, 2027, at the Augusta Marriott at the Convention Center. Nurse educators from Georgia and other states share research and evidence-based teaching practice through invited talks, podium presentations, hands-on workshops and a poster competition, alongside the annual business meeting. NLN chief executive Beverly Malone is among the featured speakers.

The program carries 12.0 contact hours approved through the Georgia Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver. Full-conference early-bird rates (until December 15, 2026) are $310 for members, $410 for non-members and $220 for students and retirees. Regular rates are $360, $460 and $250, and single-day tickets are available.
